notes.title: Until Next Time
notes.content:
As you may have noticed, our Kickstarter campaign was not successful.

It’s been one heck of a ride and I’d just like to thank each and every one of you that believed in us.

I will be taking this as a chance to take a break from game development for a while but rest assured that this isn’t the end of Metanormal. Somehow in someway, it’ll live on.

The demo will stay up on both Steam on itch.io too.

If you would like to join me on the journey ahead, feel free to follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/The2ndGame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/thesecondgame/]Instagram[/url].

Again, thanks for being by our side.

Until next time.


- Luis Maya
